mapper.select: SELECT UID, UserName, LoginPwd, Gender, Email, Phone, Status, CreateTime, Remark, Avatar FROM users WHERE UserName = #{userName} LIMIT 1
SELECT UID, UserName, LoginPwd, Gender, Email, Phone, Status, CreateTime, Remark, Avatar FROM users WHERE Email = #{email} LIMIT 1
SELECT UID, UserName, LoginPwd, Gender, Email, Phone, Status, CreateTime, Remark, Avatar FROM users WHERE Phone = #{phone} LIMIT 1
SELECT UID, UserName, LoginPwd, Gender, Email, Phone, Status, CreateTime, Remark, Avatar FROM users WHERE (Email = #{account} OR Phone = #{account}) AND Status = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT UID, UserName, LoginPwd, Gender, Email, Phone, Status, CreateTime, Remark, Avatar FROM users ORDER BY UID DESC

SELECT u.UID, u.UserName, u.Gender, u.Email, u.Phone, u.Status, u.CreateTime, u.Remark, u.Avatar FROM users u INNER JOIN userroles ur ON u.UID = ur.UID WHERE ur.RID = #{roleId} AND u.Status = 1 ORDER BY u.UID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (UserName, LoginPwd, Gender, Email, Phone, Status, Remark, Avatar) VALUES (#{userName}, #{loginPwd}, #{gender}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{avatar})
